items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I managed to get a couple of very instructive periods with Rudy Weedoff... I think he taught me a great deal.

ctx.x: B-u-e-c-h. And another man by the name of Arthur Kruger. And they were both very fine. And actually, later I took some lessons from a man by the name of [Veesee] Walker, whose son was here in California and has been for a number of years, I believe, and he was music director and head of the band program at USC for a number of years, Tom Walker.

And at one point, I guess maybe when I was about 12, 13, I managed to get a couple of very instructive periods with Rudy Weedoff when he was touring and happened to be in Milwaukee. And it was arranged for me to have a couple of hours with him. And I think he taught me a great deal.
